# Dubai Architecture Encyclopedia — Full Machine-Readable Knowledge Base
# Version: 2026.1
# Domain: https://dubai-architecture.info
# Standards: CTBUH height criteria, DLD Open Data, Mollak service charge registers, Law No. 85 of 2006 (RERA).

================================================================================
1. PROJECT MISSION & ETHICAL CHARTER
================================================================================
Dubai Architecture (dubai-architecture.info) was established in 2006 as an independent architectural archive documenting Dubai's urban transformation from a regional port to a global skyscraper capital.
Key principles:
- Zero paid developer bias: No developer can purchase ranking positions or favorable due diligence ratings.
- Independent engineering audit: Height metrics adhere strictly to CTBUH (Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat) architectural height standards.
- Cadastral integrity: Financial benchmarks reflect actual Dubai Land Department (DLD) transaction records, not developer marketing brochures.
- Multi-jurisdictional accessibility: Fully localized across 10 languages: English (en), Russian (ru), Arabic (ar), Hindi (hi), Chinese (zh), German (de), French (fr), Urdu (ur), Italian (it), and Turkish (tr).

================================================================================
2. SKYSCRAPERS & TOWERS CATALOG (36 TOWERS)
================================================================================

---
Tower: Burj Khalifa
Slug: burj-khalifa
URL: https://dubai-architecture.info/buildings/burj-khalifa/
Architectural Height: 828 m (2717 ft)
Floors: 163
Completion Year: 2010
District: Downtown Dubai
Architect: Adrian Smith
Developer: Emaar Properties
Structural System: Reinforced concrete buttressed core with high-performance outriggers
Estimated Gross Yield: 6.8% Net
Service Charge (Mollak): 55.8 AED/sq.ft
District Cooling: Consumption-Billed (Empower)
Description: The undisputed centerpiece of Dubai's skyline and the world's tallest freestanding structure. Inspired by the desert Hymenocallis flower, Burj Khalifa features a stepped buttressed core that mitigates severe high-altitude vortex shedding without relying on a mechanical tuned mass damper.

Completion Year: 2000

District Cooling: Consumption-Billed (Empower)
Description: The twin equilateral triangular towers that defined modern Dubai's rise at the dawn of the 21st century. Clad in aluminum panels and reflective copper glass, connected by the two-storey retail boulevard 'The Boulevard'.

Description: The crown jewel of Dubai's next maritime frontier on Palm Jebel Ali. Featuring sculpted aerodynamic forms inspired by Gulf ocean swells, private marina slips, and 110 kilometers of crystalline beachfront coastlines in a sustainable, renewable-powered archipelago twice the size of Palm Jumeirah.

---
Tower: South Bay Executive Towers
Slug: south-bay-towers
URL: https://dubai-architecture.info/buildings/south-bay-towers/
Architectural Height: 76 m (249 ft)
Floors: 18
Completion Year: 2026
District: Dubai South & Expo City
Architect: LACASA Architects & Engineering
Developer: Dubai South Properties
Structural System: Reinforced concrete moment frames with post-tensioned slabs and piled foundation
Estimated Gross Yield: 8.5% - 9.8%
Service Charge (Mollak): 13.5 AED/sq.ft
District Cooling: Consumption-Billed (Empower)
Description: Flanking a 3-kilometer crystal freshwater lagoon, South Bay Executive Towers represent the premier residential address in Dubai South. Capitalizing on the historic $35 billion Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC) expansion to create the world's largest aviation, logistics, and innovation metropolis.

================================================================================
5. UAE 10-YEAR GOLDEN VISA VIA REAL ESTATE
================================================================================
- Minimum Real Estate Investment Threshold: 2,000,000 AED (~$545,000 USD / ~€505,000 EUR).
- Property Types: Freehold residential or commercial properties located in designated investment zones.
- Mortgaged Properties: Permitted provided the cash equity paid to the bank/developer is at least 2,000,000 AED with a formal bank NOC.
- Off-Plan Properties: Permitted if purchased from DLD-registered developers with an official Oqood certificate and minimum 2M AED valuation.
- Visa Validity: 10 years, renewable indefinitely as long as the property asset is retained.
- Family Sponsorship: Includes spouse, children of any age, and domestic staff.
- Absence Restriction Exemption: Golden Visa holders can stay outside the UAE for more than 6 months without invalidating residency.
- Tax Status: 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, 0% wealth tax in the UAE.
